name: bybot-app
description: Gestión de usuarios, archivos, procesos y análisis IA.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,yellow,magenta "npm -w backend run dev" "npm -w backend run worker" "npm -w frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w backend run build && npm -w frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm -w backend run typecheck && npm -w frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm -w backend run test && npm -w frontend run test
